files.name: summary.json
files.description: Headline results: per (model, condition) next-action prediction accuracy (macro) mean + 95% CI + per-user array; lucky_guess line; real move distribution.

files.name: manifest.json
files.description: Experiment config: the 10 models with backend ids (OpenRouter / Gemini API / Modal) + reasoning efforts + concurrency, split file, taxonomy, judge model, n_per_user, n_points, git sha, timestamp.

files.name: taxonomy.json
files.description: The v2 4-way move taxonomy: categories (approve/critical/directive/inquiry), the exact classifier prompt body, OLD->NEW remap from the legacy 7-way, and inter-judge kappa.

files.name: splits.json
files.description: Train/val/test split with NON-OVERLAPPING users AND repos (connected components of the user<->repo graph); qualifying eval-users per split.

files.name: points.jsonl
files.description: The 480 frozen held-out prediction points (one JSON per line): {point_id, slug, repo, turn_index, prev_agent, real_text}.

files.name: raw.jsonl
files.description: Every trial (one JSON per line). Generation: {key, kind:'gen', point_id, slug, model, model_id, backend, effort, cond('distilled'|'generic'), text, ts, seed?}. Move label: {key:'lab:haiku:<hash>', move}. Join gens to labels via the 4-way classifier on (prev_agent, text).

files.name: cases.json
files.description: Case-study data for glm-5.2 / gemini-3.1-pro / osim-4b: per-developer accuracy ±profile (delta), and every moment where the profile flipped the move (with the agent turn, real message+move, and both ±profile generations+moves).

files.name: category_recall.json
files.description: Per-move agree-rate (recall) for all models, both conditions: of moments whose real move was X, the fraction the sim matched. Includes the profile delta per category. Drives the by-category heatmap.

files.name: verbosity.json
files.description: Average + median message length (words) per model, both conditions, vs the real developers; plus each model's accuracy no-profile/with-profile. Drives the verbosity chart.

files.name: ablation.json
files.description: Contrastive-prefix ablation for glm-5.2 + gpt-5.5: accuracy under no-profile vs the real persona vs a content-free terse style prefix, with spurious-inquiry rate, word count, and per-move recall.

files.name: scaling_context.json
files.description: Context-window ablation for gemini-3.5-flash (no profile): accuracy per N=1..10 prior session turns plus the full 14-turn anchor, per-developer values, on all 480 moments and the 166-moment constant-dose (>=10 prior turns) subset. Drives the context-window chart.

files.name: scaling_flash_k.json
files.description: Cross-session history sweep for gemini-3.5-flash (no profile): accuracy per K in {0,2,4,8,16,32,64} most recent train turns prepended at the full 14-turn live window (K=0 = the leaderboard generic run), plus K in {8,64} at a 1-turn live window (substitution test), per-developer values and paired tests. Drives the cross-session chart.

files.name: scaling_grid.json
files.description: The completed coarse N x K surface for gemini-3.5-flash (no profile): accuracy at every (N in {1,2,4,8,14} live turns) x (K in {0,4,16,64} history turns) cell, per-developer values, paired K-effect tests at each N and the N1-vs-N14 interaction test. Drives the grid table.
